name: Ecem Ozturk
bio:
Ecem [ pronounced A-Gem ] is a designer and art director based in Toronto. Her practice moves between brand identity, editorial direction and immersive 3D.

She holds a BA in Design (Interior Design) & an MDes in Digital Futures. Her interests circle tactility, objects and memory in a tech-infused world.
about:
Obsessed with finding new worlds to enter, Ecem seeks inspiration everywhere she goes.
She has lived in Istanbul for most of her life, then left home for university. First to New York, then to Milan; she learned how to establish a home away from home at a quite early age. 
Her Bachelor's degree in Milan concentrated on Interior Design. Her thesis, an interior renovation project of a public third-space near Milan, was concluded with a project book. 
After exploring mobile game industry in Istanbul for a year, she decided to attend OCAD for a Masters in Design. 
This brought her to Toronto, where she now calls home.
